availability.note: BYD AU Build & Price (bydautomotive.com.au/configurator/sealion-7 redirects to the evdealergroup-byd.com.au host; working slug is byd-sealion-7) lists exactly two grades, Premium and Performance, both priced; Victoria selectable

listPrice.note: configurator vehicle price $54,990 with GST field = price/11 and on-road fees added separately; CarExpert 2026 review states $54,990/$63,990 'before on-road costs' in words; Chasing Cars '$54,990 + ORCs'. $4,000 cashback (orders 1 Oct-21 Dec 2026) is a campaign, not applied

batteryKwh.note: usable; EV Database gives 82.5 usable / 84.0 nominal for the same 82.5 kWh pack (EU car). BYD AU quotes 82.56 kWh unlabelled for both grades

rangeKm.note: BYD AU spec table quotes both 'Combined range WLTP 482km' and NEDC (567km); WLTP taken. Matches EV Database EU WLTP for the same variant

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: BYD AU owner's handbook technical data: 19.9 kWh/100km (WLTP) beside 17.0 (NEDC); held value was the NEDC figure. WLTP figure includes charging losses, 16% above usable/range (17.1); same grid-figure convention as tesla-model-y, xpeng-g6, zeekr-7x

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: BYD AU 2026 brochure spec 'Rear trunk capacity (L) 500'; 58L frunk not added (brochure's 558L 'combined'). Measurement standard not stated; BYD EU quotes 520L

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: EV Database 'Cargo Volume Max' 1,789L (BYD EU figure); BYD AU publishes no folded figure. Likely to the roof rather than the belt line

towKg.note: BYD AU owner's handbook: maximum towing capacity (braked) 750 kg rear-wheel drive, 1500 kg four-wheel drive

warrantyYears.note: Vehicle warranty 6 years/150,000km; traction battery 8 years/160,000km

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; anchored to byd-seal-premium ($52,990, $1,600) and xpeng-g6-standard-range ($51,800, $1,750)

depreciationCurve.note: BYD brand convention used by most BYD rows (Seal 6, Atto 1/2, Sealion 5/6, Dolphin, Shark 6 realigned today); held value unchanged. BYD runs repeated cashback campaigns ($4,000 to 21 Dec 2026), which argues against anything gentler
